FOUR real bugs blocking the recent-changes checklist: (1) password sheet is MISSING the required 'Minimum 10 characters.' hint, (2) connect sheet is MISSING the 'Other wallets · not ZK-native' dropdown + wallet-other-toggle (only Camo Wallet card renders — ensureWalletGroup in camo-app.js guards on non-own wopt siblings which React never mounts), (3) Create button in password sheet has transparent bg + near-white text (opposite of spec 'light button, dark text'), (4) BLOCKING: 'Open Camo Cash' button on recovery screen navigates to a 'This page couldn't load — Reload / Back' error view, vault state is NEVER persisted (localStorage only holds cc-tour-v1 + cb-theme), so the final camo2… address is never surfaced to the user. Recovery key prefix camosk2 is correct ✓.

critical_code_review_comments: camo-app.js is now 1819 lines — splash, nav, tour, wallet overlay, fee-summary all live in one file. Three iterations in a row have landed one-line fixes to adjacent surfaces here (iter32 regex, iter33 X handle on a sibling file, iter34 missing hint). This file is a drift magnet; splitting into brand/boot.js, brand/nav.js, brand/wallet-overlay.js would localize future breakage.

ensureWalletGroup() tightly couples to React's render output (requires non-.wopt-own siblings). A safer contract: the overlay should synthesize the three fallback wallets itself when a `data-wallet-fallbacks-missing` sentinel appears, rather than silently rendering an incomplete connect sheet.

rca of the issue: Vault-open blocker RCA (hypothesis, not yet pinned down because the error screen gives no stack): the recovery-key dialog's primary CTA appears to trigger a client-side navigation (likely to /app or /app/vault) BEFORE the wallet state (seed, address derivation) has been committed to localStorage. The destination route's guard then sees no vault, redirects, and the fallback error boundary renders 'This page couldn't load'. Repro: landing → Open app → Connect wallet → Camo Wallet → password hunter2testxx x2 → Create → acknowledge recovery → Open Camo Cash → error screen; localStorage after flow contains ONLY cc-tour-v1 + cb-theme. Mitigation: ensure the Open Camo Cash handler writes wallet state synchronously (await setItem) BEFORE navigating, and that the destination route reads from the same key. Also add an error-boundary telemetry log so the next failure surfaces a message instead of just 'This page couldn't load'. Hint-missing + dropdown-missing + create-button-styling RCA: these are three independent spec items that were updated in the paraphrase/overlay layer (camo-app.js fixCreateCopy + ensureWalletGroup + .card.onb button CSS) but not actually landed in the deployed overlay — either the fixCreateCopy branch for 'Minimum 10 characters.' is gated behind a condition that never fires, or the paraphrase JSON entry is missing. Grep /app/backend/brand/paraphrase.json for 'Minimum 10' to confirm. Dropdown issue is a React/overlay contract mismatch (ensureWalletGroup needs siblings React is no longer rendering).
